planets.name: TOI-1231 b
planets.description: Transiting planet of TOI-1231 with a 24.2-day year, found in 2021.

text.card: TOI-1231 b was found in 2021 by TESS as it crossed its star.
text.introduction: It is the only planet known around TOI-1231. Its orbit and size follow Burt et al. 2021's fit, the archive's default.
